name: hybrid_expansion
why: Won the 100-query comparison table: highest nDCG@10 then Recall@10 among lexical, dense, hybrid, and hybrid+expansion. Hybrid beats a single signal; expansion (original query kept) adds recall.
tradeoff: Mean retrieve latency ~27s/query vs ~80ms for weighted hybrid without expansion (one extra LLM round-trip). Cost $0 on Ollama; hosted models bill that call. UI defaults expansion off.
